metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for the Shoofi platform (5 repos). Distributes shared skills and domain-owner subagents so local sessions AND cloud routines/Slack agents can use them across every repo.

plugins.name: shoofi-testing
plugins.description: Testing across the 5 Shoofi repos. cover-changes generates the tests covering a finished feature/bug in whichever repo(s) it touched, bootstrapping test infra on first use. local-app-e2e stands up the local stack and drives the customer/partner/driver apps through their real UI on an iOS simulator with Maestro.

plugins.name: shoofi-domains
plugins.description: Domain-owner subagents — one full-stack 'employee' per territory: menu-catalog, orders, payments (money in), accountant (money out/settlement), delivery, customers. Each loads a human-reviewed context doc (CORE + reference), inherits the shared safety constitution, and ships work as PRs. Includes docs-check, a drift checker that fails the build when a doc stops matching the code.

plugins.name: shoofi-operators
plugins.description: Operator ('department head') subagents — Class B. They own a BUSINESS FUNCTION rather than a slice of code: they feed on data and the outside world and ship decisions, alerts, briefs and drafts, never product code. Their gate is human approval, not tests. First operator: competitive-intel (Haat / Tira Eat coverage and price gaps, and the competitor-store to our-store matching everything else depends on).
